title: Pan-Seared Celeriac with Greek Twist
description: A French-inspired dish with the earthy flavor of celeriac, crispy from a skillet pan.
instructions: Peel and slice the celeriac into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
Season the celeriac slices with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add the celeriac slices to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Mince the garlic and sprinkle it over the celeriac.
In a small bowl, mix together the Greek yogurt and fresh dill.
Serve the celeriac slices with the yogurt sauce spooned over the top.
